name: Lundberg Family Farms Organic Thin Stackers (Lightly Salted Rice Cakes)
whyItWorks: Puffed brown and white rice crisped into ultra-thin stackable crackers. Puffed starch expands cell walls making them fragile and quick to dissolve upon chewing, satisfying crunch cravings without stricture danger.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Eat straight from the pack or spread with smooth sunflower seed butter or honey.
